source: Set the current slice number. Slice number is used to load a 2D slice from a 3D input image. If the input image is 2D, then the slice number if ignored. The direction of the slice is determined by SliceMode.
translation: 设置当前切数 。 切片号用于从3D输入图像中装入2D切片. 如果输入图像为2D,那么如果忽略了切片数字. 切片的方向由SliceMode决定.

source: The Elevation filter generates point scalar values for an input dataset along a specified direction vector. The Input menu allows the user to select the data set to which this filter will be applied. Use the Scalar range entry boxes to specify the minimum and maximum scalar value to be generated. The Low Point and High Point define a line onto which each point of the data set is projected. The minimum scalar value is associated with the Low Point, and the maximum scalar value is associated with the High Point. The scalar value for each point in the data set is determined by the location along the line to which that point projects.
translation: Elevation 过滤器会沿着指定的方向向量生成输入数据集的点刻度值. 输入菜单允许用户选择将应用此过滤器的数据集. 使用 Scalar 范围条目框来指定要生成的最小和最大比例值 。 低点和高点定义了数据集每个点的预测线. 最低scalar值与低点相关,最高scalar值与高点相关. 数据集中每个点的刻度值由该点项目所在线上的位置决定.

source: Control whether the input point data is to be treated as categorical. If the data is categorical, then the resultant cell data will be determined by a majority rules vote, with ties going to the smaller value.
translation: 控制输入点数据是否被视为绝对数据 。 如果数据是绝对的,那么产生的单元格数据将由多数规则的投票决定,而关联的数值会较小。

source: This reader reads unstructured grid MPAS data from a file. It creates a dual grid It assumes the grid is in the global domain. By default, it creates a spherical view of vertical layer 0. It assumes it is ocean data. It gives several options to change the view to multilayer (all vertical layers will have a thickness determined by the value in the slider), lat/lon projection or atmospheric (vertical layers go out away from the center of the sphere, instead of down towards the center as they do for ocean data). It doesn't handle data in the rectangular domain. This is not a parallel reader. It expects one .nc file of data. It can display cell or vertex-centered data, but not edge data. When converted to the dual grid, cell-centered data becomes vertex-centered and vice-versa. NOTES: When using this reader, it is important that you remember to do the following: 1. When changing a selected variable, remember to select it also in the drop down box to color by. It doesn't color by that variable automatically 2. When selecting multilayer sphere view, start with layer thickness around 100,000 3. When selecting multilayer lat/lon view, start with layer thickness around 10 4. Always click the -Z orientation after making a switch from lat/lon to sphere, from single to multilayer or changing thickness. 5. Be conservative on the number of changes you make before hitting Apply, since there may be bugs in this reader. Just make one change and then hit Apply. For problems, contact Christine Ahrens (cahrens@lanl.gov)
translation: 此读取器从文件中读取无结构的网格 MPAS 数据 。 它创造了双网格 它假设电网属于全球域. 默认情况下,它会产生垂直层0的球形视图. 它假设它是海洋数据。 它提供了几种选择,将视图改为多层(所有垂直层的厚度都由滑动器中的数值决定),拉特/龙投影或大气(垂直层从球体中心外向,而不是像海洋数据那样向中心下向). 它不处理矩形域中的数据. 这不是一个平行的读者。 它期望一个.nc的数据文件. 它可以显示单元格或以顶点为中心的数据,但不能显示边缘数据. 当转换成双网格时,单元格中心数据会变成顶点,反之亦然. 注:在使用该读取器时,必须记住: 1. 修改选定的变量时,请记住在下移框中也选择该变量的颜色。 它的颜色不是由变量自动2。 选择多层球面视图时,先从一层厚度约10万3. 在选择多层拉特/龙视图时,先从10 4左右的层厚度开始. 在从lat/lon切换到球体,从单层到多层或改变厚度后,总是单击-Z方向. 5. 在点击应用程序前要保守更改的次数,因为这个阅读器可能存在错误。 只要做一个改变,然后点击应用。 如有问题,请洽Christine Ahrens (cahrens@lanl.gov)

source: This filter uses a greedy algorithm to convert triangles into triangle strips
translation: 此过滤器使用一个贪婪的算法将三角形转换成三角形条形

source: The compression algorithm used to compress binary data (appended mode only). None offers fastest write, LZ4 offers the fastest compressed write, ZLib offers balanced performance, LZMA offers smallest compressed filesize.
translation: 用于压缩二进制数据的压缩算法(仅应用模式). 无提供最快的写法,LZ4提供最快的压缩写法,ZLib提供平衡性能,LZMA提供最小的压缩文件大小.
